etsy.title: Command S Poster, Save Your Work Tech Humor Print, Funny Office Gift, Dark Mode Wall Art
etsy.description:
A funny Command S poster for every creative who saves compulsively, because it will crash and it is not a matter of if but when, in dark-mode colors.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang for a home office, dev den, or coding setup.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Etsy has a market page for 'ctrl_s' confirming buyers search for the save shortcut; results are mostly stickers and keycap art, not posters.
The dominant Ctrl-key poster is 'Everything Is Under Ctrl', a pun on control, sold as digital downloads ($4) and framed prints (up to $40).
A 'CTRL + S Save The Day' cartoon floppy-disk poster was listed at $71 framed, showing high-end pricing for keyboard humor.
Most tech humor posters on Etsy are digital downloads; physical prints are less common and command higher prices.
Amazon keyboard humor is dominated by Ctrl Alt Del signs and banners, not Ctrl/Command S specifically.
A keyboard shortcut reference chart is sold as an unframed 12x18 poster for office decor.
Amazon titles use 'office decor', 'motivational', and 'computer lab' as audience words.

research.notes: 'Command S poster' chosen because the printed artwork reads 'Command + S' (the Mac save shortcut). Etsy indexes 'ctrl_s' as a market phrase, validating buyer interest in the save shortcut concept. The poster is broadly relatable beyond programmers to designers, writers, and anyone who has lost work to a crash. No priceRange: comparable physical posters were not found at consistent prices.
